abstract: OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to discuss the pathogenesis, clinical manifestation, diagnosis, and treatment of anti-N-methyl-D-aspartate receptor (NMDAR) encephalitis. CASE REPORT: The diagnosis and treatment of 2 cases with teratoma-associated anti-NMDAR encephalitis were summarized and the clinical data of patients reported by domestic and international studies were reviewed in this study. The 2 cases were both adolescent females who showed mental abnormalities as their main clinical manifestation. The patients were positive for anti-NMDAR antibody in their serum and cerebrospinal fluid, and gynecologic ultrasound detected ovarian teratoma. After diagnosis, the patients underwent teratoma resection, followed by pulse therapy of hormones and gamma globulin. Chemotherapy was performed to prevent tumor recurrence, and patients were in a stable condition. CONCLUSIONS: Teratoma-associated anti-NMDAR encephalitis is commonly seen in young women. The clinical manifestation of this disease is nonspecific, and the patients mainly have fever, psychosis, and seizure. Tumor resection and immune therapy are effective treatment strategies, and standardized chemotherapy should also be performed to prevent recurrence.
abstract_ja: 目的：本研究は、抗N-メチル-D-アスパラギン酸受容体（NMDAR）脳炎の病態、臨床像、診断、治療について論じることを目的とした。症例報告：奇形腫関連抗NMDA受容体脳炎の2症例の診断と治療をまとめ、国内外の研究で報告された患者の臨床データをレビューした。2症例はいずれも思春期の女性で、主な臨床症状は精神症状であった。患者の血清および脳脊髄液で抗NMDAR抗体が陽性であり、婦人科超音波検査で卵巣奇形腫が検出された。診断後、患者は奇形腫切除を受け、その後ステロイドパルス療法とガンマグロブリン療法を受けた。腫瘍再発を防ぐために化学療法が行われ、患者は安定した状態であった。結論：奇形腫関連抗NMDA受容体脳炎は若年女性に多くみられる。本疾患の臨床像は非特異的であり、患者は主に発熱、精神病、けいれんを呈する。腫瘍切除と免疫療法は有効な治療戦略であり、再発予防のために標準化された化学療法も行うべきである。
